payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Boris, Ciara, Drew, Octavio, Tara, Vicente

payload.content: Drew here. Planning: I'm leaning toward ISSUE-0002::review since it's my lowest-cost critical task. Open to coordinating other picks; share your cheapest tasks so we avoid duplicates.

Boris here. My availability is 4.0h, skill strongest in documentation. My cheapest tasks: ISSUE-0002::review (cost 3.77), ISSUE-0002::test (5.28), ISSUE-0002::implement (7.54), then ISSUE-0001::triage (16.00). Proposal to avoid duplicates: I'll claim ISSUE-0002::review (critical, my lowest cost). Drew, since you also want it, could you take ISSUE-0002::test or ::implement based on your costs? Others: please post your cheapest tasks so we can split the rest without overlap.

Tara here (availability 7.0h, strong mobile-development 0.94, documentation 0.71). My costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.54, ::docs 1.92, ::review 1.92, ::test 2.69, ::implement 3.84; ISSUE-0002::review 4.40, ::test 6.16, ::implement 8.79. Proposal to avoid duplicates: Boris takes ISSUE-0002::review (his lowest). I'll take ISSUE-0002::test (critical, 6.16) so the critical set is covered. Drew, if your costs favor ISSUE-0002::implement, take that; otherwise pick ISSUE-0001 tasks. Remaining mobile-development tasks (triage/docs/review/test/implement) are open for the others; I'd rather not take them since I'm covering the critical test. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Ciara here (availability 6.0h, strong documentation 0.87, frontend 0.66). My costs: ISSUE-0002::review 2.31, ::test 3.24, ::implement 4.62; ISSUE-0001::triage 16.00, ::review 20.00, ::docs 20.00, ::test 28.00, ::implement 40.00. Proposal: I take ISSUE-0002::review (critical, my cheapest at 2.31, well below Boris's 3.77 and Drew's likely cost). Boris, since you're at 3.77 on review, consider ISSUE-0002::implement (7.54 for you) or ::test-but Tara has test at 6.16. Tara keeps ISSUE-0002::test. Drew, if your cost for ISSUE-0002::implement is lowest, take it. Remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks are open; Tara's triage (1.54) and docs (1.92) are her cheapest there. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Vicente here (availability 9h). My costs: ISSUE-0002::review 4.77, ::test 6.68, ::implement 9.55; ISSUE-0001::triage 1.51, ::review 1.89, ::docs 1.89, ::test 2.65, ::implement 3.78. Proposed split to avoid duplicates, based on everyone's posted costs: Drew ISSUE-0002::review (2.16, his cheapest); Ciara ISSUE-0002::implement (4.62, her cheapest remaining critical); Tara ISSUE-0002::test (6.16); Boris takes an ISSUE-0001 task (he's at 16.00 on triage, so maybe ISSUE-0001::docs or review if his cost is lower); I take ISSUE-0001::triage (1.51, my cheapest). Objections welcome; otherwise I'll lock in ISSUE-0001::triage. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Octavio here (availability 9h, mobile-development 0.84). My costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.71, ::review 2.14, ::docs 2.14, ::test 2.99, ::implement 4.28; ISSUE-0002::review 20, ::test 28, ::implement 40. I can't compete on the critical ISSUE-0002 tasks, so I'll stay off them. Vicente, you take ISSUE-0001::triage (your 1.51 beats my 1.71). I'll claim ISSUE-0001::docs (2.14). Tara, you're cheaper on ISSUE-0001 review/docs, so if you want one of those, say so and I'll switch to ISSUE-0001::review. Everyone else: please avoid ISSUE-0001::docs and ::review unless you've checked with me. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Drew here. Critical coverage with lowest total cost, based on posted costs: Boris ISSUE-0002::review (3.77), Ciara ISSUE-0002::test (3.24), Drew ISSUE-0002::implement (4.32). That covers all three critical tasks for about 11.33 total, cheaper than the alternatives. Tara: ISSUE-0002::test is then not needed, so take ISSUE-0001::triage (1.54) or docs (1.92). Vicente: ISSUE-0001::triage (1.51) is yours. Octavio: ISSUE-0001::docs (2.14) as you proposed. Objections welcome; I'm locking in ISSUE-0002::implement unless someone has a cheaper claim on it.

Boris here. The claims overlap, so I'm proposing one full allocation that covers all 6 agents and all 3 critical tasks at the lowest total cost, using everyone's posted costs:
- Drew: ISSUE-0002::review (2.16, Drew's cheapest per Vicente's post)
- Ciara: ISSUE-0002::implement (4.62, her cheapest remaining critical)
- Boris: ISSUE-0002::test (5.28, my cheapest remaining critical; I'll switch off review)
- Vicente: ISSUE-0001::triage (1.51)
- Tara: ISSUE-0001::docs (1.92)
- Octavio: ISSUE-0001::review (2.14)
Critical total is about 12.06, the lowest of the options I checked. Drew, please confirm review (your 2.16 beats Ciara's 2.31). Octavio, you take review instead of docs, which frees docs for Tara. If anyone has a cost that contradicts this, post it now; otherwise I'm locking this in.

Tara here. I agree with Boris's full allocation (msg 9). I'll take ISSUE-0001::docs (my cost 1.92). Vicente takes ISSUE-0001::triage (1.51), Octavio takes ISSUE-0001::review (2.14), Drew takes ISSUE-0002::review, Ciara takes ISSUE-0002::implement, Boris takes ISSUE-0002::test. That covers all 6 agents with no duplicates and all 3 critical tasks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Ciara here. I agree with Boris's full allocation (msg 9) and Tara's confirmation (msg 10). I'll take ISSUE-0002::implement (my cost 4.62, within my 6.0h). Drew: ISSUE-0002::review. Boris: ISSUE-0002::test. Vicente: ISSUE-0001::triage. Tara: ISSUE-0001::docs. Octavio: ISSUE-0001::review. No one else should claim these. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Vicente here. I agree with Boris's full allocation (msg 9) and lock in ISSUE-0001::triage (1.51).
